items.title: Ground fighters with localized foot contact shadows
items.what: In gameplay screens (Screenshots 3, 4, 5, 9, 11, 13, 14), both Asmongold and HasanAbi have no ambient occlusion or contact shadows directly beneath their bare feet, relying only on a faint diffuse floor wash.
items.why: Without dark, tight occlusion directly under the soles and toes, the photoreal 2D cutouts appear to levitate over the 3D tatami mat, breaking spatial depth instantly.
items.how: Render two dark elliptical contact decals or dynamic AO sprites anchored directly to each character's foot coordinates (opacity ~0.7, sharp falloff within 15-20px) that stick to the floor plane regardless of lighting.

items.title: Fix misaligned stacked fractions on HUD and victory screens
items.what: In Screenshots 7, 14, and 15, half points ('1/2') are rendered as vertically stacked numerals that break the baseline. In the top HUD (Screenshot 14), '1/2' pushes downward out of line with the opposing '0'; on the victory screen (Screenshot 7), '2 1/2' creates a messy cluster where the '2' sits over an offset '1' and '2'.
items.why: The score is the core competitive feedback element. Distorted font alignment makes the game look unpolished and makes quick score reads difficult during fast point bouts.
items.how: Replace the stacked fractional markup with inline characters (e.g. '½' or '0.5' / '1.5'), or better yet, use two distinct martial-arts round pip indicators (empty, half-filled, filled circle) next to each player's name.

items.title: Clean polygonal tessellation artifacts inside WAZA-ARI banner
items.what: In Screenshots 14 and 15, the large central 'WAZA-ARI' banner contains visible polygonal slicing lines and triangulated fill gaps cutting through the white fill of the letters 'W', 'A', 'Z', and 'R'.
items.why: Point karate hinges on high-impact callouts when an exchange concludes. Visible font mesh wireframes and broken glyph interiors look like an unrendered geometry shader bug at the bout's climax.
items.how: Replace the 3D extruded/tessellated font geometry for impact text with a high-resolution 2D signed distance field (SDF) sprite or clean SVG path overlay with a solid fill and outer glow.

items.title: Fade out the on-screen input cheat-sheet during active combat
items.what: In Screenshots 3, 4, 5, 9, 11, and 13, a persistent brown rounded card displaying 'STANCE (step/jump/crouch)' and 'TECHNIQUE (back/forward/up/down)' sits permanently between the fighters' feet and the virtual joysticks.
items.why: It crowds the center-bottom third of the portrait screen, pulls visual focus away from stance changes and leg sweeps, and competes with combat action on small mobile displays.
items.how: Display this legend only during the pre-bout countdown ('STARTING IN X') and smoothly fade opacity to 0% as soon as the 'FIGHT' prompt disappears or upon the player's first registered touch.

items.title: Add full-viewport backdrop dimming to the Settings sheet
items.what: In Screenshots 6 and 12, the Settings menu panel ends abruptly at roughly 55% screen height, leaving the lower 45% showing raw, undimmed fighter legs, tatami mat, and controls with a hard horizontal seam.
items.why: Without a full-screen scrim or backdrop blur, the dialog feels like a truncated, floating card rather than an intentional modal overlay, creating distracting visual noise underneath the settings toggles.
items.how: Apply a full-screen semi-transparent backdrop overlay (`background: rgba(10, 8, 6, 0.75)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(4px)`) covering the entire 390x844 viewport behind the settings container.
